chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ziyād ibn Marwān, from Yūnus ibn Ẓabyān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade that one should perform salat (prayer) upon a grave, or sit upon it, or lean upon it, or build upon it.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نَهَىٰ: forbade; indicates prohibition in this legal context

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbid regarding graves?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a prohibition from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding certain acts in relation to graves. It indicates legal restraint concerning praying on graves, sitting on them, leaning on them, and building over them.
